# Comics Come Alive

> Comics Come Alive (comicscomealive.com) is a free, family-friendly website of original animated comics, old-school newspaper comic strips, 3D choose-your-own-adventure comic worlds and educational games for kids ages 1 to 7. Everything runs in a web browser on phones, tablets, computers and WebXR VR headsets, with no account or download. It is powered by Eye To Ad Media (https://eyetoad.com), a Denver-headquartered marketing and web studio.

Every character and story is original. The site guide is Captain Kapow, a caped comic hero. Content is always positive, built around kindness, confidence, generosity and humor. Kids sections have no ads and collect no information; the optional face swap photo stays on the visitor's device.

## Pages

- [Home](https://comicscomealive.com/): overview of every comic, world and game.
- [The Adventures of Fluffles](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/): a free, original comic series about Fluffles, a real smooth-coated black guinea pig with a white band around the middle and a white stripe on top of the head, drawn as a cartoon. Fluffles lives with best buddy Biscuit (a ginger-and-white guinea pig), Dot the ladybug and a kind family called the Tall Ones. 24 episodes in mixed comic styles: old-school black-and-white daily strips, full-color Sunday pages, vertical-scroll webtoons, animated motion comics, silent comics and choose-a-panel interactive comics. Every episode ends with a kid-friendly guinea pig care fact (Fluffles Fact) and has a full text transcript. Episodes:
  - [Episode 1: Meet the Real Fluffles](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/meet-the-real-fluffles/): Scrapbook opener (Sunday color + a real photo). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs are not pigs, and they do not come from Guinea! They are rodents, also called cavies, and their wild cousins live in the grassy Andes mountains of South America.
  - [Episode 2: The Crinkly Bag](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-crinkly-bag/): Daily strip (Old-school black and white). Fluffles Fact: When a guinea pig hears a sound that means food, like a crinkly bag of hay, it often lets out a loud, happy squeal called a "wheek."
  - [Episode 3: The Vitamin C Case](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-vitamin-c-case/): Sunday page (Full color Sunday). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs cannot make their own vitamin C, just like people. They need some every day from fresh veggies like bell peppers, plus good guinea pig pellets.
  - [Episode 4: A Buddy Named Biscuit](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/a-buddy-named-biscuit/): Vertical scroll (Modern webtoon). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs are social herd animals, and most are happier with a guinea pig buddy. New friends should meet slowly, on neutral ground, with a grown-up helping.
  - [Episode 5: The Mysterious Tunnel](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-mysterious-tunnel/): Vertical scroll (Modern webtoon). Fluffles Fact: In the wild, guinea pigs are prey animals, so they feel safest when they have places to hide. Every guinea pig should have its own hidey house or tunnel.
  - [Episode 6: Popcorn Lessons](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/popcorn-lessons/): Motion comic (Animated, tap to play). Fluffles Fact: "Popcorning" is when a happy guinea pig suddenly hops straight up, sometimes twisting in the air. It usually means they feel safe and excited.
  - [Episode 7: The Vacuum Monster](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-vacuum-monster/): Daily strip (Old-school black and white). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs startle at loud noises. When they are scared they may freeze or dash to a hiding spot, so give them a calm, quiet place to live.
  - [Episode 8: The First Snowflake](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-first-snowflake/): Silent comic (No words, just pictures). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs are indoor pets. They are most comfortable around 60 to 80 degrees F (16 to 27 C) and should be kept away from cold drafts, heaters and hot sun.
  - [Episode 9: The Cucumber Caper](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-cucumber-caper/): Daily strip (Old-school black and white). Fluffles Fact: Cucumber is mostly water, so it is fine as a small snack sometimes. Leafy greens and veggies are everyday foods, but hay is always the main meal.
  - [Episode 10: The Vet Visit](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-vet-visit/): Vertical scroll (Modern webtoon). Fluffles Fact: A guinea pig's front teeth never stop growing! Chewing lots of hay keeps them worn down, and a yearly vet checkup helps keep teeth healthy.
  - [Episode 11: The Box Was Better](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-box-was-better/): Sunday page (Full color Sunday). Fluffles Fact: Plain cardboard boxes, with no tape, staples or ink, make great free hideouts and chew toys. Guinea pigs love hidey spots with two doors.
  - [Episode 12: The Shiny Wheel](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-shiny-wheel/): Daily strip (Old-school black and white). Fluffles Fact: Exercise wheels and rolling balls are not safe for guinea pigs, because their backs are not built for them. Instead they need a roomy cage and safe floor time to run.
  - [Episode 13: Picnic Pick](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/picnic-pick/): Choose a panel (Interactive: you pick). Fluffles Fact: Some foods are never safe for guinea pigs, like chocolate, onions, garlic, avocado and potatoes. Always check with a vet or a trusted care guide before sharing a new food.
  - [Episode 14: The Other Guinea Pig](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-other-guinea-pig/): Silent strip (Old-school, no words). Fluffles Fact: A guinea pig's eyes are on the sides of its head, so it can see almost all the way around, but not right under its own nose. Its whiskers help it feel what is close by.
  - [Episode 15: Midnight Munchies](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/midnight-munchies/): Vertical scroll (Modern webtoon). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs do not sleep all night like you. They take lots of short naps, day and night, and sometimes they even nap with their eyes open!
  - [Episode 16: The Great Weigh-In](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-great-weigh-in/): Daily strip (Old-school black and white). Fluffles Fact: Weighing a guinea pig once a week on a kitchen scale is an easy way to spot health problems early. A sudden drop in weight is a reason to call the vet.
  - [Episode 17: The Hay Fort](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-hay-fort/): Sunday page (Full color Sunday). Fluffles Fact: Hay should make up most of a guinea pig's diet and be available all day long. It is great for their tummies and their teeth.
  - [Episode 18: Brush Day](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/brush-day/): Motion comic (Animated, tap to play). Fluffles Fact: A low, soft purr with a relaxed body usually means a guinea pig is content. Smooth-coated guinea pigs need only gentle brushing now and then; long-haired ones need it every day.
  - [Episode 19: The Wheek Concert](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-wheek-concert/): Motion comic (Animated, old-school color). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs learn the sounds of their daily routine. Many wheek loudly when they hear the fridge open or a veggie bag rustle, because snack time might be coming.
  - [Episode 20: Dot at the Window](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/dot-at-the-window/): Vertical scroll (Modern webtoon). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs love fresh grass, but it should come from a yard with no weed killer or chemicals, be rinsed first, and never come from a lawn mower bag.
  - [Episode 21: Gotcha Day](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/gotcha-day/): Sunday page (Full color Sunday). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs can live 5 to 7 years, and some live even longer. That is a lot of Gotcha Days, so caring for one is a big and happy promise.
  - [Episode 22: Where Should Fluffles Explore?](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/where-should-fluffles-explore/): Choose a panel (Interactive: you pick). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs chew almost everything, including electrical cords. Floor time should always be supervised, in a safe space with no wires or gaps to squeeze into.
  - [Episode 23: The Thunderstorm](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/the-thunderstorm/): Vertical scroll (Modern webtoon). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs feel braver together. During loud storms or fireworks, a buddy, a hidey house and a calm, quiet room help them feel safe.
  - [Episode 24: Fluffles Meets Captain Kapow](https://comicscomealive.com/fluffles/fluffles-meets-captain-kapow/): Sunday page (Full color crossover). Fluffles Fact: Guinea pigs have a real-life superpower: baby guinea pigs, called pups, are born with fur, open eyes and teeth, and they can run around just hours after they are born!
- [Animated Comics](https://comicscomealive.com/animated-comics/): interactive motion comic strips for kids, teens and adults: "Gus Can't Fire" (a baby dragon who sneezes instead of breathing fire), "Sent." (a group chat disaster), "The Yogurt Job" (a noir breakroom mystery with a flashlight panel), "Captain Kablam and the Very Big Ladder" (a pop-up 3D comic) and "Kapow vs. the Self-Checkout" and "Fluffles and the Walking Bag". Includes a slideshow mode and an optional read-aloud voice.
- [Daily Funnies](https://comicscomealive.com/newspaper-comics/): a vintage newspaper page with eight original four-panel strips (Rascal's Route, Bolt, Hoot's Library, Rexx Reports, Sir Doodle, plus new Fluffles, Bolt and Hoot's Library strips), an add-color toggle, a word jumble and classifieds.
- [Sunday Comics](https://comicscomealive.com/sunday-comics/): full-color Sunday funnies ("Captain Kapow and the Sunday Pancakes", "Blip Learns Earth", "Captain Kapow and the Kite Rescue", "Blip Learns Earth: Umbrellas"), a Captain Kapow coloring page with PNG download, and links to public-domain historic comics at the Library of Congress and the Billy Ireland Cartoon Library.
- [Kids Learning Games](https://comicscomealive.com/kids-learning-games/): Kapow's Toybox Island, a 3D learning world for ages 1 to 7 with Color Garden, Counting Pond, Shape Blocks, ABC Balloons, Music Rainbow, Animal Friends and the Kindness Tree. Explore mode for toddlers, Learn mode with questions for ages 4 to 7.
- [Princess Castle](https://comicscomealive.com/princess-games/): a 3D castle world with Kitty Princess Phoenix Sparkles, princess dress up, a magic wand window game, tea party counting, nighttime and fireworks.
- [VR Comics](https://comicscomealive.com/vr-comics/): 3D choose-your-own-adventure comics: "The Yogurt Job" (find clues with a flashlight, question suspects, solve the case) and "Kablam's Sky Adventure" (27 paths to the moon).
- [Kapow's Dojo](https://comicscomealive.com/krav-maga-game/): a 3D Krav Maga point sparring game with bag training, belts, a bot opponent with three levels and 2-player mode. Sponsored by Do-Krav Combatives, a KAPAP Krav Maga school led by Sensei David (7th Dan) at 9165 Lowell Blvd, Westminster, CO 80031, 720-583-4977, https://mmatrainingdenver.com.
- [Bedtime Stories](https://comicscomealive.com/bedtime-stories/): The Sparkles Family Adventures, free read-along picture-book stories with word highlighting: "The Great Pancake Tower", "Camping with Coburn" and "The Lost Crown".
- [Make a Comic](https://comicscomealive.com/make-your-own-comic/): a free three-panel comic strip maker with backgrounds, characters, speech bubbles and sound effects, plus a grown-ups-only form to pitch comic ideas (unpaid, not confidential).
- [Advertise](https://comicscomealive.com/advertise/): custom branded comics, sponsored strips, sponsored 3D worlds and branded characters for businesses. Custom quotes. Sponsored content is always labeled. Phone 1-800-481-8638.
